DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dimDates'[MonthYear])),
			NOT('dimDates'[MonthYear] IN {BLANK()})
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"Closed"}, 'FactTaskProductivity_HH'[OpenClosedFlag])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"Closed"}, 'dimBillingPeriod_HH'[BP_OpenClosedFlag])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable4 = 
		TREATAS({"07051-RP: HOME HEALTH"}, 'dimAlternateLocationHierarchy'[RP Combined])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		CALCULATETABLE(
			VALUES('dimDates'[YearNumber]),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable2),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable3),
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0FilterTable4)
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(501, __DS0Core, 'dimDates'[YearNumber], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'dimDates'[YearNumber]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dimDates'[MonthYear])),
			NOT('dimDates'[MonthYear] IN {BLANK()})
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"Closed"}, 'FactTaskProductivity_HH'[OpenClosedFlag])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"Closed"}, 'dimBillingPeriod_HH'[BP_OpenClosedFlag])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable4 = 
		TREATAS({"07051-RP: HOME HEALTH"}, 'dimAlternateLocationHierarchy'[RP Combined])

	VAR __DM3FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'dimDates'[YearNumber])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				'dimDates'[YearNumber], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal",
				ROLLUPGROUP('dimDates'[MonthYear], 'dimDates'[MonthFirstDay]),
				"IsDM1Total",
				NONVISUAL(__DM3FilterTable)
			),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			__DS0FilterTable4
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'dimDates'[YearNumber],
			1,
			[IsDM1Total],
			0,
			'dimDates'[MonthFirstDay],
			1,
			'dimDates'[MonthYear],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	'dimDates'[YearNumber],
	[IsDM1Total] DESC,
	'dimDates'[MonthFirstDay],
	'dimDates'[MonthYear]

			"Billing_Periods_Ending_Total", '__Measures'[Billing Periods Ending Total],
			"VPE", '__Measures'[VPE],
			"VPE___RN", '__Measures'[VPE - RN],

			"Ending_Assessments__for_Hosp_", '__Measures'[Ending Assessments (for Hosp)],
			"v30_Day_Rehospitalizations", '__Measures'[30 Day Rehospitalizations],
			"Hospitalization_w_in_30_Days", '__Measures'[Hospitalization w/in 30 Days],
			"Admissions_30_Days_", '__Measures'[Admissions 30 Days+]
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(
			102,
			__DS0Core,
			'dimDates'[YearNumber],
			1,
			'dimDates'[MonthFirstDay],
			1,
			'dimDates'[MonthYear],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'dimDates'[YearNumber], 'dimDates'[MonthFirstDay], 'dimDates'[MonthYear]
